target_customer: AI voice providers and enterprises in banking, contact centers, healthcare and insurance
problem: AI-generated voice cannot be reliably attributed or authenticated, since metadata is stripped on phone calls.
business_model: Platform licensing of watermarking and voice agent authentication
product_category: AI audio watermarking and voice authentication

founders.name: Slavko Kovačević
education: PhD candidate in Computer Science (institution not named)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; first author of the DeepMark Benchmark paper at an ICLR 2025 workshop.

founders.name: Kosta Pavlović
education: PhD in Computer Science (institution not named)

competitors.name: Resemble AI (PerTh)
competitors.what: Neural audio watermarker applied by default to Resemble-generated audio
competitors.traction_then: Deployed across its own generated audio

competitors.name: Digimarc
competitors.what: Digital watermarking, announced next generation audio authentication in July 2025

competitors.name: Pindrop
competitors.what: Contact center fraud detection and voice authentication, no watermarking per a rival's claim

technical_complexity.rationale: Watermarks must survive compression, phone calls and attacks at under 2 ms per second of audio, which is research-grade; the founders publish papers on it.

defensibility.rationale: Research depth and published benchmarks help, and a first platform license plus a Deepgram use are reported, but rivals have watermarkers too.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals shipped watermarkers; no acquisition of DeepMark found.

market_need_then: Regulation such as the EU AI Act Article 50 (per Resemble's pages, unverified) and rising voice deepfake fraud drive demand for watermarking.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and technical, 'Mark what you generate. Prove what you ship.'

branding.brand_signature: Mark what you generate. Prove what you ship.
branding.community_and_virality: Research citations and a benchmark paper give credibility in the field; no consumer buzz found.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name that fits the product but confusable (DeepSeek, Deepgram) and no press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: DeepMark grew out of University of Montenegro watermarking research, with benchmark papers, a reported platform license with a voice AI provider and a Muvi partnership from February 2026. No exit or shutdown was found. Risks are rival watermarkers and unclear demand timing, so the outcome is open.
notes: Funding unverified, from aggregators only: VCBacked $879K pre-seed (September 2025) with Lighthouse Ventures; Caplight pre-seed (January 2025) with Katapult Accelerator, Zero One Hundred, Lighthouse Ventures and a Montenegro Innovation Fund grant; Dealroom $125K seed. No round recorded, but partial coverage because some funding exists. Caplight says founded 2023 and Kolasin while YC says 2025 and San Francisco. Customers named on the site are research citations, not confirmed customers. Competitor sources are dated 2025 and 2026, near but not exactly at founding.
